proposals.evidence: Platts p. 946 explicitly distinguishes Persian/Hindi lāl “red” from the unrelated affectionate/nursery and saliva homonyms. Only the color response belongs to this loan family. Existing Hindi lal “red” (kannauji[p. 92]) supplies an attested provisional donor. Its locality is the attestation site; the historical lending locality and possible intervening Indo-Aryan language remain unknown. The borrowed edge is saved under the user’s explicit preference to link supported families despite unresolved cross-IA transmission.
